messages:
kim_sales: Heads-up: prospect (EuroPayments) wants a formal answer on BYO-CMK architecture and specific SOW language. Requirements: automated rotation every 45 days, ability to perform emergency rollback to previous CMK, 7-year log retention, and proof that inference requests tie to customer CMK. They also asked about throughput impact and whether Redwood can host an HSM during POC.
rafa_solutions: High-level options: 1) Envelope encryption (recommended): Redwood derives short-lived data keys under the customer CMK and caches them in the runtime; CMK ops happen on rotation/initial derive. 2) Per-request CMK decrypt: cryptographic gold standard but large perf and KMS-call costs. 3) Hybrid: per-request for a sampled % (audit), envelope for rest.
sana_security: For SOW include: rotation cadence (45 days), key escrow/attestation schedules, KMS provider and region, log retention 7y, key retention window (keep previous keys for 90 days), emergency rollback runbook, and pen-test window pre-cutover. Require customer to maintain CMK ownership and provide attestation reports and KMS account whitelists.
tom_sre: Perf specifics: per-request CMK decrypt adds ~5-30ms tail (depends on KMS region and network). Envelope caching reduces per-request cost to sub-ms, with CMK calls limited to rotation/canary. For high QPS recommend batching rewraps, connection pooling to KMS, and an in-memory key cache with TTL ~1h. If they insist on per-call CMK ops, plan for additional autoscaling on worker nodes to absorb latency.
kim_sales: Customer asks: can Redwood host an HSM for the POC so they don't need to provision right away?
rafa_solutions: We can offer a temporary hosted HSM (dedicated tenant) under a limited SOW for POC. Its not typical but doable; will need explicit data access agreement, and runbook for key handoff at end of POC. Pricing will reflect the operational overhead.
sana_security: Add to SOW: must define custody transfer steps post-POC, attestation reports for hosted HSM, and clear deletion/retirement steps for the hosted CMK.
kim_sales: Customer wants exact wording we can send to their security team tonight. Can someone draft a concise blurb?
rafa_solutions: Draft: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYO-CMK) via HSM-backed KMS providers. For production we recommend envelope encryption: ephemeral data keys are generated under your CMK and cached by Redwood's runtime; CMK operations are limited to key derivation and rotation, which minimizes latency and provider billing while maintaining cryptographic separation and an auditable trail. For customers that require per-request CMK validation, Redwood can enable per-call decrypts (higher latency and KMS costs) or a hybrid sampling model for audit. The SOW will record rotation cadence (45d), a 90d grace for old keys, monthly attestation delivery, a rollback runbook, and 7-year log retention. If a hosted HSM is required for the POC, Redwood can provision one under a temporary operational agreement; custody handoff post-POC will be coordinated as part of onboarding." 
doc-bot: Created doc /presales/1742001234-byo-cmk-options-hosted-hsm-poc for follow-up.
sana_security: Also: include automatic rollback thresholds: if error rate >0.5% or latency regresses >30ms during canary, trigger automatic rollback to previous key. Keep previous key material available for 90 days for emergency decrypt.
kim_sales: Great — I'll send this and open a pricing thread if they want hosted HSM quote. :thumbsup:
